sources.locator: Page 1: title block, Ordering Information table row BAS70-04-7-F, polarity diagrams figure (BAS70-04) and footer
sources.evidence_extract: Title block: "BAS70/ -04/ -05/ -06 SURFACE-MOUNT SCHOTTKY BARRIER DIODE". Ordering Information: BAS70-04-7-F | SOT23 | 3000 | Tape & Reel. Polarity figure: BAS70-04 drawn as two series diodes, the single opposite lead is the junction node; pin numbers are not printed in this document. Footer: "Document number: DS11007 Rev. 27 - 2", "November 2023", "(c) 2023 Copyright Diodes Incorporated". A5 recorded no sha256 for https://www.diodes.com/_files/datasheets/ds11007.pdf (engineering/a5/electronics/source_provenance.json id BAS70_04 lists the URL and retrieval refs only, 2026-11-05/06); bytes inspected now (2026-11-08): f512dac149186bf0c0a3d454d19c3e09d802116dd7f19eb62ee5384d89100896, 5 pages, Content-Type application/pdf; identity with A5's bytes cannot be established.
